Cities & Knights Expansion Implementation
description: Implement the complete Cities & Knights expansion for Settlers of Lanc following the detailed implementation plan in docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md. This epic adds commodities, city improvements, knights, barbarian attacks, progress cards, and metropolises to the game.

title: Phase 1: Foundation - Type Definitions
description: Establish type system foundation. CREATE commodity-constants.ts, MODIFY player.ts/game.ts/board.ts to add C&K types (commodities, improvements, knights, metropolises). Est: 2-3 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 1

title: Phase 10: UI Components - Panels
description: Create UI components for C&K state. CREATE CommodityHand.tsx, CityImprovements.tsx, KnightControls.tsx, BarbarianTrack.tsx, EventDieDisplay.tsx, ProgressCardHand.tsx. Est: 4-5 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 10

title: Phase 11: Board Rendering - Knights & Metropolises
description: Update board to show knights and metropolises in BOTH flat and voxel themes. CREATE KnightRenderer.tsx, themes/flat/Knight.tsx, themes/voxel/Knight.tsx. MODIFY VertexRenderer.tsx. Est: 6-8 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 11

title: Phase 12: Game Initialization & Lobby
description: Enable C&K mode selection and initialization. MODIFY game-service.ts:startGame() and lobby-view.tsx to add game mode selector. Initialize C&K state when selected. Est: 2-3 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 12

title: Phase 13: Main Game Controller Integration
description: Wire all C&K components into main game interface. MODIFY GameController.tsx to conditionally render C&K panels and add action handlers. Est: 3-4 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 13

title: Phase 14: Edge Cases & Polish
description: Handle edge cases and manual testing. Address tied players, deck exhaustion, metropolis immunity, simultaneous claims, event die + 7 roll. Full game playthrough testing. Est: 4-6 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 14

title: Phase 15: Automated Testing
description: Create unit tests for critical path logic. CREATE tests/ck/barbarian-attack.test.ts, knight-strength.test.ts, metropolis-transfer.test.ts. Test edge cases and tiebreakers. Est: 3-4 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 15

title: Phase 2: Commodity & Improvement Systems
description: Implement commodity production and city improvement mechanics. CREATE commodity-manager.ts and improvement-manager.ts. Integrate with rollDice(). Est: 3-4 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 2

title: Phase 3: Knight System
description: Implement knight placement, activation, movement, and combat. CREATE knight-manager.ts and knight-validator.ts. Knights cost 1 sheep + 1 ore, activation costs 1 wheat. Est: 6-8 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 3

title: Phase 4: Barbarian & Event Die Systems
description: Implement barbarian invasion and event die rolling. CREATE barbarian-manager.ts and event-die-manager.ts. Barbarian attacks at position 7, compares city strength vs knight strength. Est: 4-5 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 4

title: Phase 5: Progress Card System
description: Implement progress card decks and effects. CREATE progress-card-definitions.ts and progress-card-manager.ts. Implement 10-12 core cards, stub remaining. Est: 6-8 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 5

title: Phase 6: Metropolis System
description: Implement exclusive city upgrades and ownership transfers. CREATE metropolis-manager.ts. Metropolis requires level 4 improvement, provides +2 VP, immune to barbarians. Est: 3-4 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 6

title: Phase 7: Service Layer Integration
description: Create service orchestration for C&K features. CREATE ck-game-service.ts, knight-service.ts, improvement-service.ts. Wire all managers to API layer. Est: 4-6 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 7

title: Phase 8: Victory Conditions Update
description: Adjust victory point calculation for C&K mode. MODIFY victory-conditions.ts to add metropolis VP and use 13 VP threshold for C&K games. Est: 1-2 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 8

title: Phase 9: API Route Handlers
description: Create HTTP endpoints for C&K actions. CREATE app/api/game/[roomId]/knight/route.ts, improvement/route.ts, progress-card/route.ts. Est: 3-4 hours. Reference: docs/cities_and_knights_implementation_plan.md Phase 9

description: UPDATED FOR V2.1: Final verified rules. MAJOR: Progress cards available at level 1+ (threshold=level+1), Knights cannot activate→act same turn. See docs/v2.1_changes_summary.md for all v2.1 updates from v2.0.

title: Feature 1: Progress Card System
description: UPDATED FOR V2.1: Progress cards use simple formula threshold=level+1. Level 1+ can draw (NOT level 3+). Level 5 always draws. ALL qualifying players draw 1 card. See docs/v2.1_changes_summary.md
acceptance_criteria:
V2.1 REQUIREMENTS (MAJOR CHANGE):
- Level 0: cannot draw
- Level 1: draws if red die 1-2 (33% chance)
- Level 2: draws if red die 1-3 (50% chance)
- Level 3: draws if red die 1-4 (67% chance)
- Level 4: draws if red die 1-5 (83% chance)
- Level 5: draws if red die 1-6 (100% - always)
- Formula: threshold = level + 1
- ALL qualifying players draw (not just one)
- Each player draws exactly 1 card
- VP cards auto-play, don't appear in hand
- VP cards display in player card
- Merchant displays in player card
- Cannot end turn with >4 cards
- Can hold 5 during turn
- Alchemy playable before roll
- All draws/reveals/warnings logged
ERROR C3 REVERSED: Level 1 CAN draw (this is correct!)

title: Feature 4: Knight Management & Combat
description: UPDATED FOR V2.1: Knight combat with timing restriction (cannot activate→act same turn), piece limits (2 basic, 2 strong, 2 mighty per player), auto-deactivation (no manual deactivate), displacement follow-up, chase robber follow-up, barbarian attack deactivation. Click knight to manage. See docs/v2.1_changes_summary.md and docs/cities_and_knights_gdd_corrected.v2.1.md
acceptance_criteria:
V2.1 REQUIREMENTS:

KNIGHT PIECE LIMITS:
- Each player has exactly 6 knights: 2 basic, 2 strong, 2 mighty
- Cannot recruit 7th knight (validation error)
- Cannot recruit 3rd knight of any type
- Dialog shows knight count (X/6 knights)

UI/UX:
- No KnightControls panel exists
- Click knight on board opens KnightManagementDialog
- Shows level, active/inactive status, strength (1/2/3)
- NO manual deactivate button (auto-deactivate only)
- Activate button (1 grain) if inactive
- Upgrade button (1 wool + 1 ore) for basic→strong, strong→mighty
- Move button shows ALL reachable intersections via own road network
- Can pass through own pieces (highlight yellow)
- Valid empty destinations (green)
- Displacement targets (red - weaker knights on own road network)
- Chase Robber button if active and adjacent to robber

MOVEMENT PATHFINDING:
- Active knight can move to ANY empty intersection connected by continuous path of own roads
- NOT limited to 1 edge - can move multiple edges in single move
- Can pass through intersections with own pieces (settlements, cities, knights)
- Cannot end on occupied intersection (even own knight)
- Requires BFS/DFS pathfinding algorithm along road network

TIMING RESTRICTIONS (v2.1):
- Can recruit and activate same turn ✅
- CANNOT activate then act same turn ❌
- CAN act then re-activate same turn ✅
- Track knightsActivatedThisTurn per turn
- Clear tracking at end of turn
- Timing violations show error with reason

AUTO-DEACTIVATION:
- Knights auto-deactivate after move
- Knights auto-deactivate after displacing enemy (moving knight only)
- Knights auto-deactivate after chasing robber
- ALL active knights deactivate after barbarian attack (win or lose)
- Displaced knight KEEPS its active/inactive status

DISPLACEMENT RULES:
- Can displace weaker knights only (not equal strength)
- Displacing knight must reach enemy knight via own road network
- Displaced knight owner must immediately relocate it:
  - To any empty intersection connected by THEIR OWN roads from displacement point
  - Uses displaced knight owner's road network (not moving player's)
  - Displaced knight keeps active/inactive status
  - Can return to original spot if connected and empty
  - If no valid destinations, knight permanently removed from board
- Displacement triggers relocation UI for displaced knight owner
- Intrigue card respects same displacement rules (virtual mighty knight strength 3)

CHASE ROBBER:
- Active knight adjacent to robber can chase it
- Chase triggers robber placement UI
- Robber placement triggers steal card logic
- Knight auto-deactivates after chase

LOGGING:
- Knight activation logged with cost
- Knight deactivation logged (move, displace, chase, barbarian)
- Displacement logged with both players
- Displaced knight relocation logged
- Displaced knight removal logged (no valid destinations)
- Chase robber logged with follow-up action
- Timing violations logged with reason
- Movement logged with start/end locations and path validation

title: Feature 5: Barbarian System
description: Fix barbarian system with v2.0 corrections: Fallback targeting system - if weakest player has no valid city (only settlements or only metropolis), target NEXT weakest. Continue until valid target found. All tied players lose cities. See docs/v2_corrections_summary.md
acceptance_criteria:
V2.0 REQUIREMENTS:
- Target player with lowest knight contribution
- If no valid city: target NEXT weakest (fallback)
- Skip if only settlements (no cities)
- Skip if only metropolis (immune)
- Continue fallback until valid target found
- If multiple tied for lowest: ALL lose a city
- Metropolises immune to destruction
- All events logged (advance, attack, defense, fallback)
NEW IN v2.0: Complex fallback targeting system
